title: The Winter of the Undercroft
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Brightwater, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
